definitions.short: Jarib , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H3402. Yarib יָרִיב proper name, masculine ( he contendeth or taketh (our) part, conducteth (our) case ; compare Sabean ירב Hal 615 ); — 1 son of Simeon 1Chr 2:24 , Ιαρειν[μ, β] , = יָכִין 1 , see below כון . 2 post-exilic names , Ιαρειμ[β] , etc.: a. Ezra 8:16 , perhaps = b. Ezra 10:18 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.
Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women:
